usage: Used for general information, data, or details you can collect, check, or share at work.
Very common in office and business contexts, especially with documents, reports, files, and customer records.
Can be uncountable in English-style teaching, but in Cantonese it works like a normal noun and is often used with verbs such as 睇, 搵, 提供, and 收集.
In formal or workplace speech, 資料 sounds neutral and practical; it is more common than very literary words.
